s.how: Toss 600g peeled king prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, the zest and juice of a lime and 2 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill over hot coals for 90 seconds a side. Serve with lime wedges.

s.note: after a dawn surf with Bodhi
s.how: Cut 500g firm white fish into strips. Whisk 120g plain flour with 180ml cold beer and a pinch of salt. Dip the fish and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Toss 2 cups shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo. Warm 12 small flour tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle mayo and coriander.

m.how: Mix 400g beef mince and 400g pork mince with 1 egg, 50g breadcrumbs, 40g grated parmesan and salt, and roll into 24 meatballs. Brown, then simmer in 700ml passata with 2 garlic cloves for 1 hour. Pack into 8 long rolls, top with 8 slices provolone and grill until melted. Two each.

w.how: Split 4 bananas lengthways into four dishes. Add a scoop each of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for fudge. Top with fudge, sliced strawberries, whipped cream, chopped nuts and a cherry.

d.how: Rub the rims of 4 tumblers with lime and dip in flaky salt, then fill with ice. Shake 180ml tequila, 90ml fresh lime juice, 60ml orange liqueur and 30ml agave syrup with ice for 15 seconds. Strain over the ice and garnish each with a lime wheel. Mix a jug ahead for the esky if you're out on the sand.
